messages:
Martin K.: Heads up — apiserver read-path latency just spiked ~10x in eu-central while we were onboarding the new RTX pool. Seeing elevated etcd read latencies and some 500s from the API. Anyone oncall noticing this?
Anya S.: Yep, seeing it. Controller-manager queue length climbing, a bunch of pods stuck Terminating. Spike started ~2026-05-12T09:12:00Z :grimace:
Tariq R.: That aligns with the rtx-oncall-2 pool attach. Possible WAL/io pressure on the kvstore during attach churn. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/graphs/etcd-read-latency (sharing)
Olga M.: Quick peek at logs — etcd leader CPU jumped and disk io queueing. I see repeated compaction messages and long read times: 
```
etcdserver: defragment triggered, compaction in progress
etcdserver: read index failed: mvcc: required revision has been compacted
apiserver: 500 GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods: upstream error
```
sre-bot: INCIDENT created #INC-2026-083 (SEV2) — paging @oncall, incident channel created.
Martin K.: Short-term mitigation idea: route read-heavy control-plane traffic to the warm-cache fallback region (us-east) or a read-replica while we stabilize. That will add cross-region egress though.
Tariq R.: I’m going to pause the onboarding rollout and scale back the batch viz job that was hammering list calls. Running: `kubectl scale deployment viz -n infra-testing --replicas=0` now.
Anya S.: Good — also lowering controller-manager QPS thresholds might reduce pressure. Note: routing to fallback will increase egress costs, we should call that out.
Olga M.: Preliminary cost estimate: if we route ~30% of read traffic cross-region for 2 hours, ~ $120/hr additional egress given current rates. Also, delayed GPU onboarding reduces reserved utilization — rough lost-revenue delta ~ $2k/mo if sustained. Can refine in 30m.
Martin K.: Plan: 1) revert the onboarding rollout 2) re-run a targeted etcd compaction/defrag with smaller windows 3) throttle onboarding jobs and heavy listers 4) postmortem + runbook updates. Who owns the rollback? @Tariq R.?
Tariq R.: On it. Rolling back the pool now — applying terraform target: `terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool.rtx_oncall` and cancelling pending attach jobs.
sre-bot: UPDATE #INC-2026-083 — rollback completed at 2026-05-12T09:36:40Z. APIServer 5xx rate dropped to ~1/min. :thumbsup:
Anya S.: Controller-manager queue is shrinking and etcd read latency trending back toward baseline. Will keep eyes on it for 60m.
Olga M.: Opening a billing alert and attaching the cost estimate to the incident. Will also add a short note about cross-region egress impact to the postmortem.
Martin K.: Thanks all. Postmortem owners: Tariq (rollback/runbook), Anya (metrics/alerts), Olga (costs). I’ll draft the incident recap and share in #incidents in ~1h.
